title: Beetle God on Throne
description: A surreal black and white drawing depicts a large beetle-headed humanoid figure with antlers and multiple eyes, seated atop a mound of smaller demonic creatures, cultists, and occult symbols. The central figure is encircled by glowing golden rings resembling planetary orbits, while the dark background is filled with floating candles, orbs, and additional insect-like figures.
prompt: A large beetle-headed demonic figure with antlers and hypnotic spiral eyes sits on a throne made of a mound of smaller devils, cultists in robes, and occult objects. The figure is encircled by glowing golden planetary rings with symbols. The dark background contains many floating lit candles and orbs. Surreal occult scene drawn in detailed black and white with selective gold accents, high contrast, mystical atmosphere.
